plugin.coffre.search: Search: name, address, login, site, tag…
plugin.coffre.f.name: Name
plugin.coffre.accesses_hint: — one per connection method (web, SSH/CLI, SNMP…)
plugin.coffre.share_hint: Sharing applies to the whole vault. « Read » allows viewing and revealing passwords; « Write » also allows adding and editing. Only the owner (and an administrator) may re-share, export or delete.
plugin.coffre.import_hint: Expected columns (separator « ; »): equipement;adresse;categorie;marque;modele;site;tags;notes;acces;libelle;login;mot_de_passe;port;url;notes_acces. Several rows sharing the same device name become several accesses of the same machine. Passwords are encrypted on save — remember to delete the source file afterwards.
plugin.coffre.history_hint: Useful when a device missed the last rotation. Every display is logged.
